failures.title: Boolean flags accept only documented spellings
failures.statement: Converting a flag to a boolean accepts only the documented spellings and rejects every other value.

failures.title: Equal version and tuple hash equal
failures.statement: A version and a tuple that compare equal always have the same hash.
failures.witness: vi=VersionInfo(0, 0, 0, 'dev0'), length=1; AssertionError: (VersionInfo(year=0, minor=0, micro=0, releaselevel='dev0'), …

failures.title: Copy without changes is equal
failures.statement: Copying an instance with no changes gives an instance equal to the original.
failures.witness: inst=HypConv(a=0, b=0, c=2); AssertionError: (HypConv(a=0, b=0, c=2), HypConv(a=0, b=0, c=4))

failures.title: Excluded fields stay out of dicts
failures.statement: A field excluded from serialisation never appears in the produced dict, and every other field does.

failures.title: Boolean strings convert strictly
failures.statement: Converting a text or number to a boolean accepts only the documented spellings in any letter case and rejects every other value.

failures.title: Masked email hides the name
failures.statement: The masked email shown during two-factor login reveals at most the first two characters of the name and always shows the domain unchanged.

failures.title: Escaping preserves text
failures.statement: Text that has been escaped renders back to exactly the original text, with no markup applied and nothing added or lost.

failures.title: Ratio distribution sums to total
failures.statement: Splitting a width among parts by ratio gives parts that add up to exactly that width whenever the width covers every part's minimum.

failures.title: Folding keeps text and width
failures.statement: Folding text to a positive width never loses or reorders characters, and no folded line is wider than the width.

failures.title: Escaped markup round-trips
failures.statement: Text escaped for markup renders back to exactly the original text.

failures.title: Folding loses nothing
failures.statement: Folding text into lines of a given width keeps every character in order, and no line is wider than the width.
failures.witness: ExceptionGroup: Hypothesis found 2 distinct failures. (2 sub-exceptions)

failures.title: Ratio parts sum to total
failures.statement: Splitting a total into parts by ratios, with minimums that fit inside the total, gives parts that add up exactly to the total.
failures.witness: ExceptionGroup: Hypothesis found 2 distinct failures. (2 sub-exceptions)

failures.title: Fitted text has exact width
failures.statement: Fitting text to a number of cells always gives text exactly that many cells wide.

failures.title: Folded lines fit and rejoin
failures.statement: Folding text to a width at least as wide as its widest character gives lines that each fit the width and together spell the original text.

failures.title: Escaped markup renders verbatim
failures.statement: Escaped text rendered as console markup shows exactly the original text.
